ns2:section.sectionText: Capital Funding for Growth Companies will provide students an understanding of the current capital market landscape, funding process and trends. (This class is not a ?calculate the lowest cost of funds? exercise.) This class will examine the range of middle-market companies? capital requirements and objectives in relation to the available private equity and debt financing. Through specific examples, students will identify the appetites and expertise of middle-market investment banks and the skills and access to capital they provide their clients. Outstanding Freshmen interested in this course should forward your request, resume and UIN to drsholem@mindspring.com.
